scenes.line1: When is your app truly handed over?
scenes.say: When can someone else support your app at three in the morning without waking you up? Let's break down what a real handover means.

scenes.label: Handbook
scenes.sub: Runbook, architecture, support model, access, monitoring, and known issues.
scenes.say: A solid handover means delivering a handbook: runbooks, diagrams, support model, access steps, and monitoring links—all in one place.

rows.b: L1 desk, L2 app, L3 eng

scenes.say: You need a runbook, clear support model, explicit access steps, monitoring setup, and formal sign-off from the business owner.

scenes.question: What’s the most missed handover step?
scenes.right: Access for end users—groups, SSO, and a clear request process. Miss this and you’ll drown in login tickets.
scenes.say: Most people forget to make end user access explicit. If you skip this, your support queue will fill with login issues on day one.
